lang_en:
Girnar was on our December trip.
I bet her 10,000 steps
was an easy morning.
She pulled it up on NakshIQ.
Difficulty, hard.
Fitness level, high.
I stopped laughing.
But December? Ten out of ten.
So we didn't cancel. We trained.
Our building's stairs, every morning.
Her hand in mine.
Pulling me up the next step.
I lost the bet. We still made it.
Travel intelligence tells you which climbs to train for.
NakshIQ.
lang_hi:
हमारी दिसंबर ट्रिप में गिरनार भी था।
मैंने शर्त लगाई, 10,000 सीढ़ियाँ
तो सुबह का खेल हैं।
उसने NakshIQ पर गिरनार खोला।
ट्रेक, मुश्किल।
फ़िटनेस लेवल, हाई।
मेरी हँसी रुक गई।
पर दिसंबर? दस में से दस।
तो हमने कैंसल नहीं किया। तैयारी की।
हर सुबह, अपनी बिल्डिंग की सीढ़ियाँ।
उसका हाथ मेरे हाथ में।
मुझे अगली सीढ़ी पर खींचता हुआ।
मैं शर्त हार गया। पर हम पहुँच गए।
ट्रैवल इंटेलिजेंस मतलब, पता होना कि किस चढ़ाई के लिए तैयारी चाहिए।
NakshIQ.

cover.hook: I bet *10,000 steps* |was an easy morning.

shots: s1: Apartment, morning: the man (late 20s) laughs and holds out his hand for a bet; the woman (late 20s) shakes it with a raised eyebrow.
s2: Close-up: she turns her phone toward him, screen glow on his face, the screen never visible; his grin fades.
s3: Apartment building stairwell, morning: the two climb concrete stairs in workout clothes, her a step ahead, him breathing hard.
s4: Girnar, morning: from behind, the two start up a long stone stairway on a hill in Gujarat, no one else on the steps.
s5: Close-up on the stone steps: her hand grips his and pulls him up the next step; both breathe hard and smile.
s6: Higher up the stairway, the two sit on a step catching their breath; he raises his hands in surrender and she laughs.
